description: Fetches structured paper records (title, authors, abstract, PDF link, BibTeX, venue, DOI, etc.) from the ACL Anthology at aclanthology.org.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_paper: Fetch a single paper by its ACL Anthology ID (e.g., "2024.acl-long.788"); requires anthology_id; 参数: anthology_id, include_bibtex; 必填: anthology_id

anthology_id.description: The ACL Anthology paper ID (e.g., "2024.acl-long.788", "2023.acl-long.41"). Used by get_paper.

include_bibtex.description: Whether to fetch and include the BibTeX citation for the paper. Used by get_paper.
